info.name: School Management API
info.description:
Postman collection for the School Management API.

## Setup
1. Import this collection into Postman.
2. Set the `baseUrl` variable to your deployed server (default: `http://localhost:3000`).
3. Use the requests below to add schools and list them sorted by proximity.

## Endpoints
- **POST /addSchool** – Add a new school.
- **GET /listSchools** – List all schools sorted by distance from a given location.

request.description: Adds a new school record to the database. All four fields are required.

response.name: 201 Created

request.description: Demonstrates validation: empty name and out-of-range latitude return 400.

response.name: 400 Bad Request
